decisions.reason: A recently launched lever handle family with several models represents tooling and catalogue investment that the firm, a long-established German hardware maker, will justify continuing well beyond one year.
The mitred handle family showcases the firm's proprietary engineering and design identity, so sunk development costs and brand commitment favor keeping it despite only modest visibility.
A multifunctional handle fits the announced barrier-free, one-stop system direction, and weak early uptake can still be blamed on the normal slow specification cycle in construction.
As a new product line within coordinated handle families, it is embedded in planning documentation and the range, which makes withdrawal after one year unlikely.
The award-winning collection has its own page and was publicly promoted, so the strong visible commitment and positive result make dropping it very unlikely.
A finish option costs little to maintain, applies across product families and supports the firm's finishing expertise, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
